ties: exact numeric equality; complete score blocks; AUROC half credit; AP noninterpolated block thresholds
acceptance: uncertainty <= threshold; complete ties only; risk is null for zero accepted
missingness: no imputation; retain official denominators; explicit maximum original-panel coverage; compare all measures again on their common eligible case set
area: right-step risk area on eligible coverage; explicitly named, not an interpolated or full-panel area
decision_timing: After inspecting this development coverage run and its reference review; not preregistered or a final protocol freeze.
